_note: Release contract (T0.6). release.yml publishes `release.version` once: when CI is green on main and the tag v<version> does not exist yet, and only if app/build.gradle carries the same versionName/versionCode. null = nothing to release. Asset names stay version-free so README links to releases/latest work; the tag carries the version.
